holdout.method: mean conditional token NLL over each answer choice; same frozen tokenizer/context; no updates

continuation.corpus_policy: Frozen v2 plus personality 250k; v3 excluded because its training gate remains closed.
continuation.scheduler: Restart a matched cosine transition from each promoted checkpoint to global step 300000; LUMEN and Transformer retain their respective approved base learning rates.
continuation.lumen_runtime_profile: Extracted from the promoted checkpoint and verified; retains the approved plasticity profile and Delta exact fast paths.

promotion_reason: Both checkpoints passed internal step, architecture, shared corpus/tokenizer hash, optimizer and RNG provenance checks and were evaluated together on the same untouched 2431-question holdout. Promoted as continuation parents, not as a claim of universal model superiority.
